At JazeeraFinds, we believe the best discoveries make everyday life more exciting. We bring together interesting finds, clever essentials, and trending products worth exploring — all in one place.

JazeeraFinds is built for the way people actually shop now: a product catches your eye in a video, and within seconds you can see what it does, what it costs, and how it gets to you. No clutter, no pressure tactics — just finds worth talking about.

Made for discovery

JazeeraFinds is designed for the way people shop now: a product catches your eye in a TikTok, Reel or Facebook post, and the store journey that follows is built to be quick to understand, with clear pricing and policies.

Contact us

Order tracking

Once your order ships, tracking details are sent to you and can be followed from the Order Tracking link in the footer — available where the carrier and destination support it.

Policies in full

Shipping, returns, privacy and terms are published as their own pages and linked in the footer, so nothing about pricing, delivery or refunds is hidden at checkout.

Delivery options, costs and timeframes depend on your destination and are shown before you pay, exactly as published in the Shipping Policy. No delivery promise is made until real rates and timeframes are set for that destination.

The full process — what can be returned, the timeframe, and how refunds are issued — is set out in the Return & Refund Policy linked in the footer.

Payments are processed on the checkout provider's encrypted payment pages. JazeeraFinds never sees or stores your full card details.

Contact support as soon as possible after ordering. Whether a change is possible depends on how far the order has progressed — the support team will confirm honestly either way.

Launch Plan

What this preview already shows, what gets configured in Shopify, and what still needs accounts or decisions — nothing below is described as live until it has been set up and tested.

Storefront design In this preview

  • Brand system (Concept 1 — Futuristic Monogram): JF monogram logo, one typeface, no clutter — with a fixed colour balance: White leads the product areas (~60%), Midnight Navy #112340 is reserved for the hero, announcement bar and footer (~25%), Matte Black #101414 carries text and key actions (~10%), and Metallic Silver appears only as the logo finish and fine highlights (~5%)
  • Mobile-first homepage: hero, featured collections, Trending, Best Sellers, New Arrivals, categories, story, trust, support, newsletter
  • Homepage hero with an animated 360° 3D showcase (five modelled finds, auto-rotating, hover to cycle products), plus a product page template with variants, quantity, Add to Cart, FAQs and recommendations
  • Working preview interactions: menu, search, cart drawer, accordions, newsletter form

Shopify configuration Next step

  • Create the collections and publish each one only when it holds real products
  • Add products with supplier-confirmed descriptions, specs, photos and genuine compare-at prices
  • Set shipping zones, rates and delivery estimates per destination; publish the policy pages
  • Connect payments and run a test checkout end to end before launch
  • Support email and business address — still to be added (the owner's supplied logo artwork is now used in the header and footer)

Marketing & analytics Needs accounts

  • Shopify Analytics — built in, active once the store exists
  • Meta Pixel — needs a Meta ad account and the Facebook & Instagram sales channel; consent settings required for UK/EU visitors
  • TikTok Pixel — needs a TikTok Ads account and the TikTok channel app
  • Google Analytics 4 — needs a Google account and the Google & YouTube channel
  • UTM parameters on every ad link so campaigns can be attributed in Shopify and GA4
  • None of these are active yet — each is verified with a test event after setup

Recommendations & apps Later / optional

  • Start native: Shopify's built-in product recommendations cover You May Also Like; Search & Discovery (free, by Shopify) covers smart search, filters and product boosts
  • Trending stays manually featured and Best Sellers ranks by real sales data — the two are never blended or faked
  • Frequently Bought Together and Picked for You personalisation only when there's enough order data to make them honest
  • Any paid app is quoted with its monthly fee before it's added — no duplicate or unused subscriptions
  • Brand consistency — same colours, type and tone on every page and template
  • Responsive — checked at phone and desktop widths, no sideways scrolling
  • Navigation & search — menu, category links and search all reach real content
  • Product accuracy — titles, prices and specs match supplier-confirmed data only
  • Cart & checkout — test order placed and paid before the store is announced
  • Policies — shipping and returns text matches the rates actually configured
  • Forms — contact form and newsletter signup tested with a real inbox
  • Tracking — each pixel verified with a test event; nothing claimed active before that
  • Performance & SEO — compressed images with alt text, descriptive titles and meta descriptions, structured data in place
  • No placeholders, no fabrication — no dead links, invented reviews, countdowns or stock claims at launch
